description: Every request/frame builder in microfreak.protocol, for slots [0, 8, 40, 127, 128, 200, 383, 384, 509, 511]. Inputs (slot, seq, name, meta) are recorded per case; 'frame' is the exact wire bytes the builder must emit. name_write_frame cases feed reply-form meta (0x10 bit set for slots >= 128, junk in meta[5]/meta[6]) to pin the direction-dependent recompute: payload[3] = meta[0] & ~0x10, payload[8] = pos, payload[9] = 0x06 — plus explicit meta variants (a hardware reply's meta verbatim, the 0x10 bit on a low slot, all-0x7F). The one chunk_frames case pins the complete 146-frame chunk stream for a seeded blob, listed under 'frames'. All byte sequences are uppercase two-digit hex, space-separated ('F0 00 20 6B ...'). Regenerate: python3 tools/gen_vectors.py (from the repo root).

blob = _synth_blob(2026, 'chunk-frames'): concatenated sha256('2026:chunk-frames:<counter>') digests, each byte & 0x7F, truncated to 4672. 145 x 0x16 + 1 x 0x17, len byte 0x20, 32 payload bytes each; seqs (i+1) % 128 continue from the go frame's 0 and wrap THROUGH 0 at chunk index 126. Chunks carry no address and no checksum.
